src/api/brands.ts: Type-only brand definitions that the generated OpenAPI types (src/api/types.d.ts) reference -- no runtime declarations, nothing to classify.
src/api/ops.ts: Type-only aliases over the generated OpenAPI schema (src/api/types.d.ts) -- no runtime declarations, nothing to classify.
src/api/payloads.ts: Type-only re-exports of generated OpenAPI response shapes (src/api/types.d.ts) -- no runtime declarations, nothing to classify.
src/outline/handlers.ts: Type-only declaration of the editor's command port (the interface useOutline implements and the components call) -- no runtime declarations, nothing to classify.
src/components/beautifulMermaid.ts: Bare re-export of the beautiful-mermaid package -- exists to name the lazy chunk and give tests a mock seam (see the file's own comment); no runtime declarations of its own, nothing to classify.
src/router.ts: Static React Router future-flag constants shared by main.tsx and every test's MemoryRouter -- a config value, not FCIS logic to classify.
src/assistant/previewKeys.gen.ts: Generated verbatim from server/src/pkm/assistant/preview_keys_dump.py (the keys each approval-card action may carry, a constant map) -- data, not hand-written logic; see the file's own generated-file comment.
src/grammar/titleWhitespace.gen.ts: Generated verbatim from server/src/pkm/title_whitespace_dump.py (the title fold's whitespace list, a string constant) -- data, not hand-written logic; see the file's own generated-file comment.
src/replica/baseSchema.gen.ts: Generated verbatim from server/src/pkm/schema_dump.py (a SQL DDL string constant) -- data, not hand-written logic; see the file's own generated-file comment.
src/replica/columns.gen.ts: Generated from server/src/pkm/rows.py and brand_registry.py (the Columns interface and its metadata tables) -- data, not hand-written logic; see the file's own generated-file comment.
src/replica/replayArbs.ts: Test-only fast-check arbitraries shared by the rewind and replay properties, excluded from unit coverage the same as testDb.ts (see vite.config.ts coverage.exclude) -- test support, not app runtime code.
src/replica/testDb.ts: Test-only in-memory sqlite-wasm helper, excluded from unit coverage the same as *.test.ts (see vite.config.ts coverage.exclude) -- test support, not app runtime code.
src/sync/memReplica.ts: Test-only in-memory Replica fake driven by the op-queue tests, excluded from unit coverage the same as src/test-helpers.ts (see vite.config.ts coverage.exclude) -- test support, not app runtime code.
src/test-helpers.ts: Shared test fixtures/mocks used only by *.test.ts files, excluded from unit coverage the same as test-setup.ts -- test support, not app runtime code.
src/test-setup.ts: Vitest global setup (jest-dom, WebSocket/matchMedia stubs), excluded from unit coverage -- test support, not app runtime code.
src/fcFilterCap.ts: Test-only cap on fast-check's .filter, installed by src/test-guards.ts and excluded from unit coverage the same as test-setup.ts -- test support, not app runtime code.
src/orphanWatchdog.ts: Test-only watchdog that ends an orphaned vitest worker, started by src/test-guards.ts and excluded from unit coverage the same as test-setup.ts -- test support, not app runtime code.
src/test-guards.ts: Vitest setup shared by the unit and property suites (the fast-check filter cap and the orphan watchdog), excluded from unit coverage -- test support, not app runtime code.
